table-index-full-component-family-public.summary: The table index module assembles all eight table sub-components — Root, Body, Caption, Cell, Footer, Head, Header, Row — into a single importable surface with both short canonical names and full descriptive aliases. This barrel file is the only import consumers need for complete table functionality.

table-root-component.title: Table Root Component
table-root-component.summary: The root container for data tables, wrapping a native `<table>` in an overflow-safe scroll container. Applies consistent sizing and caption positioning while exposing a bindable DOM reference.

table-row-component.title: Table Row Component
table-row-component.summary: A styled `<tr>` wrapper that provides hover, selection, and transition behaviors for table rows. Exposes a bindable ref and forwards all native HTML table row attributes.

table-widget-schema-driven-data-grid-wit.title: Table Widget — Schema-Driven Data Grid with Row Interaction
table-widget-schema-driven-data-grid-wit.summary: A flexible data table widget that renders structured row/column data with automatic column detection, multiple visual variants, an optional status indicator column, and full Ripple event system integration for row-click actions. It normalizes several column definition formats to accommodate the range of shapes that AI-generated specs may produce.

tabs-component-public-api-index.title: Tabs Component Public API Index
tabs-component-public-api-index.summary: The barrel file for the Tabs component family, re-exporting all four sub-components plus variant utilities under both short and verbose names. Establishes the single import point consumers use to access the entire tabs system.

tabs-content-panel-component.title: Tabs Content Panel Component
tabs-content-panel-component.summary: The content panel for an individual tab, delegating visibility control to the `bits-ui` Tabs primitive. Adds consistent typography sizing, flex growth, and outline removal while forwarding all primitive props.

tabs-layout-widget.title: Tabs Layout Widget
tabs-layout-widget.summary: A tabbed panel widget wrapping shadcn Tabs that accepts tabs as either plain strings or `{value, label}` objects, normalizes them into a consistent shape, and manages active tab state with support for both internal control and external value binding. Each tab panel only renders its content when active, preventing hidden panels from running their child effects.

tabs-list-container-with-variant-support.title: Tabs List Container with Variant Support
tabs-list-container-with-variant-support.summary: The container that holds tab trigger buttons, supporting `default` (pill/background) and `line` (underline) visual variants. Uses `tailwind-variants` for variant composition and adapts layout for both horizontal and vertical orientations.

tabs-root-component.title: Tabs Root Component
tabs-root-component.summary: The root orchestrator for the tabs system, wrapping `bits-ui`'s `Tabs.Root` primitive with a bindable `value` prop and orientation-aware flex layout. Serves as the context provider for all child tab components.

tabs-trigger-button-component.title: Tabs Trigger Button Component
tabs-trigger-button-component.summary: The clickable tab button that activates a content panel, with an extensive Tailwind class composition covering active state, focus visibility, dark mode, orientation adaptation, and an animated line-variant underline indicator.

terminal-widget-read-only-and-interactiv.title: Terminal Widget — Read-Only and Interactive Log Display
terminal-widget-read-only-and-interactiv.summary: A styled terminal emulator widget for Ripple that renders sequential log lines with per-type color coding (stdout, stderr, info, command) and optionally exposes a command input field. Auto-scrolls to the bottom when new lines arrive, making it suitable for streaming agent output, build logs, or shell session playback.

test-suite-dashboardmanager-widget-crud-.title: Test Suite: DashboardManager — Widget CRUD, Reorder, and Change Events
test-suite-dashboardmanager-widget-crud-.summary: Comprehensive unit tests for DashboardManager covering widget add, remove, update, move, reorder, bulk load, ID generation, and the onChange subscription system. Tests verify that mutations produce correct state and reliably fire change callbacks, while load() deliberately does not trigger callbacks.

test-suite-eventdispatcher-phase-b-multi.title: Test Suite: EventDispatcher — Phase B Multistep Flow Actions
test-suite-eventdispatcher-phase-b-multi.summary: Behavior specs for the Phase B multistep event dispatcher, covering all action types including flow, branch, confirm, validate, delay, api, and invoke. Tests also verify backwards compatibility with the legacy flat-array dispatch pattern and enforce nesting depth limits.

test-suite-for-button-widget.title: Test Suite for Button Widget
test-suite-for-button-widget.summary: Vitest + Testing Library test suite for the Button input widget covering rendering, variant and size data attributes, click event firing, disabled and loading state enforcement, spinner slot rendering, type attribute forwarding, and the data-state machine. Uses userEvent for realistic interaction simulation.

test-suite-for-c4-elk-layout-utilities.title: Test Suite for C4 ELK Layout Utilities
test-suite-for-c4-elk-layout-utilities.summary: Vitest unit tests for `elk-layout.ts`, covering the `getNodeType`, `isGroupNode`, and `computeElkLayout` functions. Tests verify correct C4 element classification and that ELK produces valid node positions for realistic diagram fixtures.

test-suite-for-card-layout-widget.title: Test Suite for Card Layout Widget
test-suite-for-card-layout-widget.summary: Vitest + Testing Library test suite covering the Card widget's rendering, structural conditionals, variant/density data attributes, interactive button behavior, and ARIA semantics. The suite validates both the happy path and defensive edge cases like non-interactive cards with onclick handlers.

test-suite-for-confirmdialog-overlay-wid.title: Test Suite for ConfirmDialog Overlay Widget
test-suite-for-confirmdialog-overlay-wid.summary: Vitest + Testing Library test suite for `ConfirmDialog`, covering state-driven mount/unmount, confirm and cancel button resolution, and the fallback path where `resolveConfirm` returns false (stale resolver after HMR). The `seed()` helper wires a real `StateManager`, `EventDispatcher`, and `WidgetRegistry` through Svelte context.

test-suite-for-input-widget.title: Test Suite for Input Widget
test-suite-for-input-widget.summary: Comprehensive Vitest + Testing Library test suite for the Input text widget, covering rendering, label/id association, size and state data attributes, type forwarding, oninput/onchange event firing, error and helper message rendering, accessibility attributes (aria-invalid, aria-describedby), and disabled/required/readOnly attribute forwarding.

test-suite-for-noderenderer-named-slot-r.title: Test Suite for NodeRenderer Named Slot Routing
test-suite-for-noderenderer-named-slot-r.summary: This test suite verifies that `NodeRenderer` correctly routes child nodes to named slots (`header`, `footer`) or the default body slot based on each child's optional `slot` field. It covers default routing, named-slot placement, multi-child same-slot stacking, unknown slot silencing, and regression-guards for specs written before slots were introduced.

test-suite-for-stat-widget.title: Test Suite for Stat Widget
test-suite-for-stat-widget.summary: Comprehensive Vitest + Testing Library test suite for the Stat display widget covering number formatting, all direction/sentiment combinations, delta chip rendering, size variants, and Lucide icon selection. Uses data attributes as stable test hooks rather than class names.

test-suite-for-stream-spec-simulation-ll.title: Test Suite for Stream Spec Simulation — LLM-Realistic Streaming Scenarios
test-suite-for-stream-spec-simulation-ll.summary: This test suite validates `streamSpec` and `parsePartialSpec` under realistic LLM-like streaming conditions using a deterministic pseudo-random chunk generator and a set of representative fixture documents. It enforces four invariants across all fixtures: final output correctness, monotonically non-decreasing node counts, no truncated enum values leaking through, and all widget types resolving to registered components.

test-suite-for-stream-spec-smoke-tests-m.title: Test Suite for Stream Spec Smoke Tests — Module Integrity and Basic Lifecycle
test-suite-for-stream-spec-smoke-tests-m.summary: The smoke tests are the first gate in the streaming test pipeline: they verify that the module is importable, exported types exist, the widget registry is intact, and the `streamSpec` store handles trivial lifecycle events correctly. These tests run fast and should catch packaging regressions before the heavier simulation and unit suites execute.

test-suite-for-streamspec-unit-tests-for.title: Test Suite for streamSpec — Unit Tests for Lifecycle, Chunking, Options, and Safety
test-suite-for-streamspec-unit-tests-for.summary: This unit test suite provides systematic coverage of `streamSpec` across lifecycle edge cases, variable chunk sizes, configuration options, safety boundaries, and cross-environment compatibility. It uses controlled synthetic generators rather than real LLM output, giving precise control over timing and content to assert exact behavior.

test-suite-layout-engine-determinelayout.title: Test Suite: Layout Engine — determineLayout and analyzeData
test-suite-layout-engine-determinelayout.summary: Unit tests for the layout engine's two public functions: `determineLayout` (maps a UniversalSpec intent and data shape to a layout string) and `analyzeData` (extracts item count and field names from a spec's data object). Tests cover all intent types, display hint overrides, browse sub-layouts, and data analysis edge cases.

test-suite-widgetregistry-register-invok.title: Test Suite: WidgetRegistry — Register, Invoke, and Unregister Round Trips
test-suite-widgetregistry-register-invok.summary: Unit tests for the WidgetRegistry class, verifying method registration, argument forwarding, idempotent unregistration, replacement safety, and edge case handling. These tests were written alongside Phase B flow actions to ensure the `invoke` action has a well-behaved backing registry.

text-display-widget.title: Text Display Widget
text-display-widget.summary:
A foundational text rendering primitive that maps a flat set of typography props — size, weight, color, and inline mode — to semantic HTML elements. Renders as a `

` block element by default or an inline `` when the `inline` prop is set.

text-input-widget-with-widget-registry-i.title: Text Input Widget with Widget Registry Integration
text-input-widget-with-widget-registry-i.summary: A fully-featured text input widget that supports labels, error/helper messages, prefix/suffix icon slots, and size variants. Uniquely, it opts into Ripple's WidgetRegistry when given an `id`, enabling the `invoke` flow action to call `focus()` on the input remotely from a spec action handler.

textarea-component-public-api-index.title: Textarea Component Public API Index
textarea-component-public-api-index.summary: The barrel file for the Textarea component, re-exporting the single `textarea.svelte` implementation under both `Root` and `Textarea` names. Provides the canonical import point for the component.

textarea-input-component.title: Textarea Input Component
textarea-input-component.summary: A styled multi-line text input that auto-sizes to content, handles validation states visually, and supports dark mode. Exposes bindable `value` and `ref` props and forwards all native textarea attributes.

textarea-input-widget.title: Textarea Input Widget
textarea-input-widget.summary: A controlled multi-line text input widget that wraps the shadcn Textarea primitive with Ripple's prop and event conventions. It maintains local state synchronized with an incoming `value` prop and surfaces `onchange`, `onfocus`, and `onblur` callbacks for flow integration.

ticker-stock-ticker-strip-with-symbol-pr.title: Ticker: Stock Ticker Strip with Symbol, Price, and Change
ticker-stock-ticker-strip-with-symbol-pr.summary: Ticker renders one or more stock quotes in a horizontally-scrollable pill strip — each showing symbol, price, and color-coded change value with optional percentage. It uses string prefix detection to determine bullish/bearish coloring, matching how financial data APIs deliver pre-formatted change strings.

timeline-chronological-event-list-with-c.title: Timeline: Chronological Event List with Color-Coded Dots
timeline-chronological-event-list-with-c.summary: Timeline renders a vertical list of dated events connected by a continuous rail line — each event has a colored dot, date label, title, and optional detail text. It supports five semantic dot types plus custom color overrides, truncation via maxItems, and a trailing overflow indicator.

toggle-switch-input-widget.title: Toggle Switch Input Widget
toggle-switch-input-widget.summary: A boolean toggle switch widget that wraps shadcn/ui's Switch primitive with an optional label layout and the same local state sync pattern used by the Checkbox widget. Provides a more visually distinctive alternative to Checkbox for on/off settings.

tooltip-component-public-api-index.title: Tooltip Component Public API Index
tooltip-component-public-api-index.summary: The barrel file for the Tooltip component family, re-exporting five sub-components — Root, Trigger, Content, Provider, and Portal — under both short and verbose names. Forms the single import surface for all tooltip functionality.

tooltip-content-bubble-with-arrow-and-an.title: Tooltip Content Bubble with Arrow and Animations
tooltip-content-bubble-with-arrow-and-an.summary: The visible tooltip bubble component, composing portal rendering, directional entry/exit animations, keyboard shortcut badge support, and a custom arrow indicator. Delegates positioning and accessibility to `bits-ui`'s Tooltip.Content primitive.

tooltip-portal-wrapper-component.title: Tooltip Portal Wrapper Component
tooltip-portal-wrapper-component.summary: A minimal pass-through wrapper around `bits-ui`'s `Tooltip.Portal`, enabling tooltip content to be rendered outside its DOM ancestor tree. Prevents clipping by `overflow: hidden` ancestors.

tooltip-provider-component.title: Tooltip Provider Component
tooltip-provider-component.summary: A shared configuration provider for tooltip groups, setting `delayDuration` to zero by default to deliver immediate tooltip responses. Wraps `bits-ui`'s Tooltip.Provider to override the library's built-in delay.

tooltip-root-component.title: Tooltip Root Component
tooltip-root-component.summary: The top-level orchestrator for a single tooltip instance, composing `TooltipProvider` and `bits-ui`'s `Tooltip.Root` with a bindable `open` state. Ensures every tooltip has provider context without requiring consumers to add it manually.

tooltip-trigger-component.title: Tooltip Trigger Component
tooltip-trigger-component.summary: A minimal wrapper around `bits-ui`'s `Tooltip.Trigger`, adding a `data-slot` identifier and exposing a bindable `ref`. Acts as the hover/focus target that activates the tooltip.

uispec-schema-gen-1-json-ui-specificatio.title: UISpec Schema — Gen 1 JSON UI Specification
uispec-schema-gen-1-json-ui-specificatio.summary: UISpec is Ripple's original (Gen 1) schema for a complete JSON-described UI. It defines the recursive UINode tree, optional data fetchers and state, theme overrides, and the parse/safeParse entry points that validate LLM-generated output before it reaches the renderer.

universalspec-schema-gen-2-intent-based-.title: UniversalSpec Schema — Gen 2 Intent-Based UI Specification
universalspec-schema-gen-2-intent-based-.summary: UniversalSpec is Ripple's second-generation schema that replaces explicit component trees with high-level intent declarations. The layout engine and pattern detector consume a UniversalSpec to auto-select layouts and data renderers, while `normalizeSpec` provides a lossless migration path from Gen 1 UISpec documents.

url-sanitizer-xss-safe-href-utility.title: URL Sanitizer — XSS-Safe Href Utility
url-sanitizer-xss-safe-href-utility.summary: A focused security utility that strips dangerous URL schemes before they reach the DOM, preventing XSS attacks through javascript:, data:, and file: hrefs. Added as a blocker fix in PR #14 when externally-supplied Pocket spec URLs were found to flow directly into href attributes.

vitest-test-setup-jest-dom-matchers.title: Vitest Test Setup — jest-dom Matchers
vitest-test-setup-jest-dom-matchers.summary: A single-line Vitest global setup file that imports the @testing-library/jest-dom/vitest extension, injecting DOM-aware assertion matchers like toBeInTheDocument, toHaveClass, and toBeVisible into every test in the suite.

widget-registry-central-component-map-an.title: Widget Registry — Central Component Map and Registration API
widget-registry-central-component-map-an.summary: The top-level widget registry for Ripple's generative UI runtime. It maintains a mutable map of string type names to Svelte components, provides a CRUD API for runtime registration, and serves as the single import point for all 40+ built-in widgets across layout, display, input, data, control, composite, overlay, research, workflow, and C4 categories.

widget-type-registry-enum-and-category-m.title: Widget Type Registry — Enum and Category Map
widget-type-registry-enum-and-category-m.summary: This module defines the `WidgetType` Zod enum (the complete set of string values the `type` field of a UINode may hold) and the `WIDGET_CATEGORIES` constant that organizes those types into named groups used by documentation, tooling, and the layout engine.

widgetregistry-runtime-widget-method-reg.title: WidgetRegistry — Runtime Widget Method Registry for Invoke Actions
widgetregistry-runtime-widget-method-reg.summary: WidgetRegistry is a per-Ripple-instance registry that allows widget components to expose named methods so declarative `invoke` flow actions can call them programmatically. It uses a nested `Map<string, Map<string, WidgetMethod>>` structure keyed by widget ID and method name, with safe unregister semantics designed for Svelte 5 `$effect` cleanup.

workflow-widget-barrel-export.title: Workflow Widget Barrel Export
workflow-widget-barrel-export.summary: The public API index for the workflow widget submodule, re-exporting the custom SvelteFlow node component, the auto-layout function, and the TypeScript types that consumers need to construct workflow specs.

workflow-widget-interactive-node-based-d.title: Workflow Widget — Interactive Node-Based Diagram
workflow-widget-interactive-node-based-d.summary: A Svelte 5 widget that renders interactive workflow diagrams using SvelteFlow (`@xyflow/svelte`). It accepts a simplified `WorkflowNodeData[]` and `WorkflowEdgeData[]` spec and handles auto-layout, type mapping, and interactivity controls transparently.

workflow-widget-type-definitions.title: Workflow Widget Type Definitions
